scope: Broader public GitHub repository discovery and six pinned source audits while frozen neural matches continue. Not an exhaustive all-repository audit, complete rule certification, new victory or strength-based suite change.
query_semantics_note: Connected search results are observations, not proof of exhaustive GitHub search semantics. A negative-term exploratory query returned apparent excluded names and is not used to assert exclusion or coverage.

entries.license: GPL-3.0 root LICENSE; bundled pybind11 has its own license
entries.disposition: Buildable Muses-family C++ hint engine/MCTS scaffold. Default God move-generator API differs from strict native rules in a fully public check fixture; no validated native-compatible playing adapter or independent strength. Not defeated.
findings: Original game/search sources build with installed pybind11 headers; no algorithm modifications.
God.Hint and Node.AIHint depth1 return an opening-legal action; opening44move set matches pinned native referee.
Direct Searcher.ai leaves root visits0; Python binding does not expose Searcher.bp. Inspected Python UCT/expand examples are tree-API demos, not an established complete MCTS playing loop.
Separate repository is not proof of an independent algorithm family; same author/AIBoard4 class and copied parent-style README indicate Muses lineage.

A separate fully public in-check probe yields15God-generated moves versus2native legal moves,13source-only moves. Its depth1AIHint still selects a native-legal escape. Opening agreement is insufficient; do not claim every hint is illegal.

Repository description mentions Jieqi, but no compatible Jieqi implementation is established from this source audit. Other behavior is not inferred from the description.

findings: Self-contained HTML implements alpha-beta/quiescence, advertised depths3/4/6.
README known limitations explicitly states search sees true identities when trying dark moves.
README also states missing long-check loss, long-chase bans and40-round no-capture draw. No modified private-observation adapter is introduced.

limitations: Repository names, stars, self-descriptions, forks and build success are not strength evidence.
Root license checks describe reviewed evidence, not a universal legal conclusion about every file.
Only the original C++/MCTS scaffold was built; no new benchmark match or promotion was conducted.
Unreviewed returned repositories include frontends, forks and unrelated solar-term/CMS/book projects. Search remains ongoing; refresh before final strong-suite confirmation.
